summary: Cold codegen of the LRE controller (run-4 iter-1): 13 Java files, all 43 requirements traced in result_codegen.json. Issues list design choices and invented defaults for user review.

issues.title: Lowercase event record names to match RoboChart event names
issues.detail: Records named reqVel/reqHdng/reqOCM/reqMOM/reqHCM/endTask and advVel/advHdng (not Java-conventional PascalCase) so extracted event names match the spec.

issues.title: Safe large distance = 1000.0
issues.detail: LRE-DM5 requires a 'safe large distance' for missing obstacles but gives no value; Sensor.SAFE_LARGE_DISTANCE = 1000.0.

issues.title: 3D CPA geometry implemented in Sensor layer (cdaTo/tcpaTo)
issues.detail: Standard CPA equations in 3D incl. depth/rate-of-climb; tcpa=-(r.v)/|v|^2, 0 when relative speed is zero; cda clamps time at >=0. Lives in Sensor because compute() may not declare locals/conditionals and division needs a guard.

issues.title: CAM entry action unspecified
issues.detail: LRE-FR4 says 'evasive manoeuvres' but DM7 limits outputs to advVel/advHdng and no requirement defines the evasive output; CAM entered with no entry action.

issues.title: Beh4 thresholds taken literally as 1.0
issues.detail: vel<=1 and odist>1 use literal 1.0, not minSafeDist (which is also 1 by default).

issues.title: cstc/cdyn keep the -1 sentinel per spec; no sentinel guards in controller
issues.detail: Fields are @RoboChartType("nat") int initialised to -1; controller predicates call sensor functions directly (sensor returns safe defaults).

issues.title: Operation invocation order in step()
issues.detail: CalcVel, CalcCStc, CalcCDyn, CheckOPEZ, CalcCPA — so CheckOPEZ sees this cycle's cstc and CalcCPA this cycle's cdyn.

issues.title: OCM passthrough as explicit self-loops
issues.detail: Beh2/Beh3 assign currentMode = OCM redundantly so the ETL extracts explicit self-transitions with the advVel/advHdng actions.

next_step: Run the deterministic pipeline (compile through vacuity) and iterate on feedback.
